query: select 'companions' as table_name, slug, published, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(metadata->'references','[]'::jsonb)) as reference_count from public.companions where slug in ('abu-huraira','salman-al-farisi','muadh-ibn-jabal','asma-bint-abi-bakr') order by slug limit 10; select 'scholars' as table_name, slug, published, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(metadata->'references','[]'::jsonb)) as reference_count from public.scholars where slug in ('shafii','bukhari','malik-ibn-anas','ahmad-ibn-hanbal') order by slug limit 10
